title: Implement Procedural Pipe Obstacle Generation and Movement
description: Create an obstacle management module that procedurally spawns vertical pipe pairs with gaps at random heights, moves them leftwards at a constant game speed, and recycles off-screen pipes.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipes spawn at regular horizontal intervals with randomized vertical gaps
Pipes move leftwards at a consistent velocity per frame
Python unit tests validate pipe generation bounds and recycling logic
reviewFeedback: The implementation successfully fulfills all acceptance criteria, correctly handles delta-time scaled movement and spawning intervals, manages off-screen pipe recycling, and includes comprehensive Node.js-based Python unit tests which pass cleanly.
